_comment: Copy to config.json and edit. Keys starting with _ are comments. Run `python -m mining_hub check` after editing.
_pause_for_processes: Process names that pause mining while they run (games, video editors).

power._manage_power_limit: true = the hub sets each profile's cap (run the terminal as Administrator). false = set it in MSI Afterburner.

Desktop.note: Quiet while you browse and work

Efficiency.note: Best MH/s per watt on memory-bound algorithms

Gaming.note: Mining off; the whole GPU is yours

economics._revenue: From WhatToMine/minerstat for your coin: USD per 1 MH/s per day, BEFORE fees. 0 = unknown.
